resources.string: Use only while parked. The wizard never sends vehicle control commands or changes driving restrictions.
Connect the head unit and start screen streaming, then return to this screen.
Head unit fingerprint differs. Reconnect the original unit before continuing.
No fully verified profile yet. Continue testing; incomplete or skipped tests are not a pass.
Best confirmed profile among tested combinations
Audio tests heard on HU: %1$d of 2
Single-touch profile: pinch zoom is not supported by this mode.
Some audio is heard on the phone, not the head unit.
Profile saved. Reconnect the head unit.
Disconnect the head unit completely before changing the test profile.
Profiles are ordered by declared capabilities. You can test any of them or stop when the result is satisfactory.
Prepare the profile while disconnected, then connect the same head unit.
All checks answered for this profile.
This removes saved test results for this run and restores the settings used before the wizard.
Play music using Android Auto on the HU. Listen for clear sound, correct channels and interruptions. Where is it heard?
Trigger a navigation voice prompt while parked. Check whether it is audible and music recovers after the prompt.
Open voice input in Android Auto and say a short harmless test phrase. Check whether it is recognized; the wizard does not record the phrase.
On the HU screen, tap a control and swipe a list. Check alignment, stuck touches and correct direction.
In a map supporting zoom, use two fingers. Check that zoom works without phantom taps.
